page.layout: One page of text, one column, set right of centre; no margin notes; closing signature block at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: re,mendacia detestari, pacem pa-triæ sartam tecta optare, ad quos fines cum hæc mea scriptio tendat, audacius eam vobis offerre, mihiq; promittere audeo, illam vobis ingratam futuram non esse. Sub hac spe finio, Deumque precor, ut dulcissimam patriam nostram perpetua pace & orthodoxa fide beare, & vos magna fidei & pacis fulcra, in ea diutissimè conservare velit.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the middle and lower part of the page and is not transcribed. The signature block uses mixed type: "Dabam ipsis Cal. Decemb." and "addictissimus" are in italic; the date and "V. V. D. D." are in capitals.
